title: Manganese doping induced record-high medium-temperature AgCuTe thermoelectrics
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02875B, Paper
Nan-Hai Li, Xiao-Lei Shi, Chao Zhang, Meng Li, Xiaodong Wang, Min Zhang, Wen-Yi Chen, Yong-Qi Chen, Dmitri Golberg, Dong-Chen Qi, Zhi-Gang Chen
Electronic band modulation induced by manganese doping decouples the electron and phonon transport properties of AgCuTe, achieving a high ZT of 1.88 at 773 K and an energy conversion efficiency of 13.3% at a temperature difference of 462 K.
